model: Pinned rl-starter-files ACModel: symbolic partial image CNN, LSTM, separate actor/critic tanh heads. No full grid, agent coordinates, room list or environment transition calls in the policy. Text and absolute direction fields are not used.
optimizer_control: Both arms use official AdamGnT with identical hyperparameters. Renewal arm applies official GnT to actor/critic head features after each optimizer update. CNN and LSTM are not renewed. Utility uses the last forward pass of the recurrent minibatch, not all unrolled timesteps.
continuity: Preserve model weights, optimizer and renewal utility state across environment stages. Reset episodic recurrent state at episode/stage boundaries. Stage identity is not supplied as model input.
evaluation: After each stage, evaluate both environment configurations with frozen weights and stochastic actions on 50 fixed fresh seeds. Preserve training RNG across evaluation. No evaluation scores are used to select checkpoints or change hyperparameters.
metrics: peak GPU allocated bytes including rollout and update tensors
scope: Closed-loop mechanism pilot and baseline, not the complete Adaptive Latent Workspace architecture. Standard tasks have 40/80-step limits; success would not establish general reasoning, learned model-based planning or very long-horizon competence. Two seeds cannot support broad statistical claims.
implementation_notes: Use synchronous vectorized environment stepping to avoid unmanaged forked workers; preserve official PPO update/rollout code. Save stage checkpoints on WD. Preflight uses separate dummy seeds and a shorter run.
